name: provider
summary: A wrapper around InheritedWidget that simplifies exposing and consuming values through the Flutter widget tree.
advantages: Lower conceptual overhead than more feature-heavy state-management frameworks
Reduces boilerplate compared with direct InheritedWidget usage
tradeoffs: State and dependency access remain tied to BuildContext/widget-tree structure
Async-heavy applications may want stronger async/caching primitives or stricter state-transition conventions
recommendedFor: Small to medium Flutter apps that want a lightweight InheritedWidget-based abstraction
Teams that prefer widget-tree-scoped dependency access

verification.reason: Current pub.dev metadata and Flutter state-management guidance are sufficient.
